headline: Explore your options
primaryText: Going the extra mile to find your perfect yacht.
whyItWorks: The big yacht photo shows the product at its most desirable and filters for the right high-end audience at a glance. The copy promises personal, tailored service rather than a price, which suits a purchase this large. The single clear enquiry button gives interested buyers an easy next step, and the carousel arrows let them browse more boats without leaving the ad.
